# Economy (`economy` v1)

An economy: output, growth, prices, jobs, policy rate and debt, and output by sector.

**Group:** Economics · **Mnemonic:** `ECON` · **Identifiers:** `ECON-…` in `economyId`

Open one with `ECON <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: economy
version: 1
description: "An economy: output, growth, prices, jobs, policy rate and debt, and output by sector."
match: { kind: economy, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Economics · Economy, id: $.economyId }
strip:
  - { label: Economy, bind: $.name }
  - { label: GDP (USD tn), bind: $.gdpUsdTn, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Real growth, bind: $.growth, fmt: pct2, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Inflation, bind: $.inflation, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Unemployment, bind: $.unemployment, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Policy rate, bind: $.policyRate, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Debt / GDP, bind: $.debtToGdp, fmt: pct0 }
panels:
  - id: growthPath
    kind: line
    title: "Real GDP growth, quarter on year"
    key: F2
    rows: $.growthPath
    x: quarter
    y: growth
    fmt: pct2
  - id: sectors
    kind: hbar
    title: Output by sector
    key: F3
    area: right
    rows: $.sectors
    label: sector
    value: share
    fmt: pct0
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.centralBank, 'central-bank-decision')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
